dedupe_keys.name: aws iot twinmaker managed service for operational digital twins of buildings plants and equipment

description: AWS IoT TwinMaker is a managed AWS IoT service for building operational digital twins of physical and digital systems such as factories, buildings, industrial plants and production lines, combining sensor data, camera feeds and enterprise data with 3D scenes. Coverage: an entity-component knowledge graph for modelling devices, equipment, spaces and processes and their relations; built-in data connectors to AWS IoT SiteWise and Kinesis Video Streams, and custom connectors (run as Lambda functions) to other stores; a scene composer that places uploaded 3D or CAD models in glTF or GLB format and overlays live data tags; a Grafana and Amazon Managed Grafana plug-in and an app kit for dashboards; and guide chapters on bulk import and export, SiteWise asset synchronisation, alarms, Matterport integration, video streaming and an Apache Flink library. Format and access: cloud console, APIs and SDKs in an AWS account, with documentation in the AWS IoT TwinMaker user guide. Licence: proprietary AWS service under the AWS customer agreement (terms not read). Cost: pay per use, charged by unified data access API calls, the number of entities and the number of queries, with basic, standard and tiered bundle pricing plans; connector Lambda functions are billed separately. Caveats: the service runs only inside AWS and the twins are built by each customer, so there is no shared data or model to reuse; exact prices by region were not read. Simulation uses: a host for asset-level digital twins of facilities and utility plants that link live telemetry to models for operations and emergency response. Related records: Azure Digital Twins (platform-azure-digital-twins) is the comparable Microsoft service.
